- skills/hormozi/scripts/validate_doctrine.py

Core commands:
- Find business context: python3 skills/hormozi/scripts/business_context.py find --start /path/to/business
- Inspect profile without linked-file reads: python3 skills/hormozi/scripts/business_context.py inspect --profile /path/to/BUSINESS.md
- Full local authority health check when requested: add --check-authorities to inspect. Resolve/sidecar writes belong to authorized setup, not ordinary advice.
- Authorized setup only: python3 skills/hormozi/scripts/business_context.py resolve --start /path/to/business
- Import licensed text equivalents: python3 skills/hormozi/scripts/corpus.py import --source-root /path/to/source-root --manifest /path/to/source-manifest.jsonl --index skills/hormozi/private-corpus/index/hormozi.sqlite
- Retrieve bounded file doctrine: python3 skills/hormozi/scripts/corpus.py query --corpus-root skills/hormozi/private-corpus --query "decision terms" --source-type file --limit 6
- Find allowed video metadata: python3 skills/hormozi/scripts/video_source.py list --corpus-root skills/hormozi/private-corpus --after START_ISO --before END_ISO --title "title words"
- Search one allowed video: python3 skills/hormozi/scripts/video_source.py search --corpus-root skills/hormozi/private-corpus --after START_ISO --before END_ISO --video-id VIDEO_ID --query "decision terms"
- Read nearby video segments: use video_source.py read with the same bounds, pinned source hashes and the needed --start-ms/--end-ms span; follow references/source-reading.md for paging. Search is not review or doctrine approval.
- Check a long or difficult draft when useful: python3 skills/hormozi/scripts/plain_language.py --file /path/to/draft.md --target-grade 3
- Replace START_ISO/END_ISO with the task's time-zone-aware publication bounds, or the saved library window if no narrower bounds were set. Keep a frozen cutoff fixed. Shorts stay excluded unless explicitly allowed.

YouTube sync ownership:
- The package defines the source contract in docs/youtube-sync.md.
- Each install owns its credentials and configured runner.
- Synced YouTube records enter the working corpus. Advisor video access uses video_source.py for metadata-first scope checks and raw segment links; file queries use corpus.py.

Important boundaries:
- Private role-play as Alex Hormozi is supported. Do not invent his real quotes, memories, or endorsement.
- Edit BUSINESS.md only on an explicit user request; use fictional files for protected-profile tests.
- Personalized advice requires relevant business facts, not approval of a complete profile. Inspect BUSINESS.md read-only; help build it when missing and ask only for gaps that change the answer.
- The working library lives in `skills/hormozi/private-corpus/`; originals may live elsewhere. Check source manifests and known roots. Private source rights are separate from the code license.
- Recent video material changes doctrine only after manual timestamp, speaker, context, and visual review.
